step1_analysis.description: A pseudo-differential amplifier utilizing NMOS input transistors and PMOS active loads. It is likely used as a variable-gain baseband amplifier stage in the direct-conversion receiver, where the bandwidth is constrained to the channel bandwidth.

voltage_gain.description: Differential AC voltage gain in the passband

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 parameters for the given W/L and bias current. Matches the 36 dB reported in the paper.

sky130_expected.calculation: fp = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cload). Assuming a 1pF load to match the baseband filter requirements: fp = 1 / (2 * pi * 131k * 1pF) = 1.21 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 1.2 MHz and 1.92 MHz, which correspond to the WCDMA baseband channel bandwidths. A 1pF load perfectly aligns the dominant pole with this specification.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the stage

sky130_expected.reasoning: The 60 mW reported in the paper is for the entire receiver. This single baseband stage consumes a small fraction of that power.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure differential gain, bandwidth, and power consumption. Uses large feedback resistors to self-bias the pseudo-differential pair into the high-gain saturation region.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Pseudo-differential baseband amplifier testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM3 VOUTn VB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM1 VOUTp VB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 VINp GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM4 N0 VINn GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Connect NMOS drains to PMOS drains
Vshort1 VOUTn N3 0
Vshort2 VOUTp N0 0

* Power and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB1 VB1 0 0.99

* Self-biasing feedback to set optimal DC operating point
Rfb1 VOUTn VINp 100Meg
Rfb2 VOUTp VINn 100Meg

* AC coupling and inputs
Cinp VINp_ac VINp 10u
Cinn VINn_ac VINn 10u
VVINp_ac VINp_ac 0 DC 0 AC 1 SIN(0 0.01 1MEG 0 0)
VVINn_ac VINn_ac 0 DC 0 AC -1 SIN(0 0.01 1MEG 180 0)

* Load capacitance (1pF sets bandwidth to ~1.2MHz)
C1 VOUTp 0 1p
C2 VOUTn 0 1p

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(VOUTp) v(VOUTn)

ac dec 100 10 100MEG
let vout_diff = v(VOUTp) - v(VOUTn)
let gain_mag = mag(vout_diff) / 2
let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
meas ac midband_gain_db find gain_db at=10k
let gain_db_3db = midband_gain_db - 3
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_db_3db fall=1

tran 10n 5u
let vout_diff_tran = v(VOUTp) - v(VOUTn)
meas tran vout_diff_max max vout_diff_tran
meas tran vout_diff_min min vout_diff_tran
let vout_diff_pp = vout_diff_max - vout_diff_min
print vout_diff_pp
quit
.endc
